materials.name: Field-survey record kit
materials.spec: Dimension log, marked A01 plan, scale targets, room/object labels and photo index.

materials.name: Full-size layout tape
materials.spec: Low-residue floor-safe tape in at least two colors for bodies and occupied/service envelopes.

materials.name: Temporary wall template film/paper
materials.spec: Removable material for TV, instruments, mirrors and mounting-zone templates.

before: Confirm access to main room, booth, closet, ceiling inspection point and electrical panels.
Print current A01–A05/E01 and M-01…M-16 sheets; use one dated datum and revision.
Test tape/labels on each retained finish.
steps: Establish the main finished-floor datum and named wall control points.
Measure shell, openings, booth/sliders, ceiling, services, gear and both raised platforms exactly as M-01…M-16 require.
Photograph every measurement with scale and keyed location.
Tape every current furniture body plus occupied, swivel, door, appliance, service and instrument-removal envelopes.
Record discrepancies and stop downstream release where fit or fabrication changes.
Issue a signed field record and photo index.
checks: Plan dimensions close and both diagonals reconcile.
Every M-number has a measured value, method, photo and responsible person.
Mockup can be walked with doors, sliders, chairs and fridge represented in operation.
handoff: Field survey lead signs the dated record.
Greg approves the occupied layout; this approval does not release unengineered attachments.

materials.name: Field-verified coordination set
materials.spec: Plans, elevations, reflected ceiling plan, details, schedules and revision log.

materials.name: Submittal and release register
materials.spec: Tracks shop drawings, samples, product data, calculations, approvals and hold points by guide item ID.

materials.name: Permit/review record
materials.spec: Written determination of landlord, building-official and inspection requirements.

before: PRE-01 field record is signed.
Conflicts C-01…C-14 have owners and resolution paths.
Each trade receives the same current revision.
steps: Redraw A01–A05/E01 from the signed field record.
Add furniture/service zones, AFF mounting dimensions, circuits/control zones and field-verified backing.
Issue substrate-specific attachment details for mirrors, TV, hangers, track, panels and cloud.
Coordinate millwork, glazing, lighting, AV, floor, acoustic and HVAC interfaces.
Record permit/review direction and inspection points.
Publish a revision log and obtain named releases before quoting or ordering.
checks: All drawings carry one revision/date and reconcile at shared dimensions.
No custom cut size or attachment relies on a concept image.
Every hold point has an owner, deliverable and release signature.
handoff: Design professional issues the construction set.
Licensed trades/design professionals supply calculations and code-specific details in their scope.

materials.name: Floor and path protection
materials.spec: Non-staining breathable protection selected for retained LVP and corridor; taped without finish damage.

materials.name: Dust containment
materials.spec: Poly barriers, zipper access, HEPA air control and vent protection compatible with occupied-building rules.

materials.name: Asset labels and move log
materials.spec: Unique removable labels, photos, destination log and cable tags for all retained equipment.

materials.name: Protected storage/crates
materials.spec: Padded, dry, secure storage sized after inventory.

materials.name: Disposal containers
materials.spec: Separated waste/recycling containers for only approved removals.

before: Approve removal drawings and inventory destination.
Licensed electrician identifies circuits before fixture work.
Confirm sliders, camera, HVAC and egress stay operational or have approved outages.
steps: Photograph and label every retained item and connection before disconnecting.
Move gear to protected storage and update the move log.
Install corridor, floor, slider, door, camera, grille and fabric protection.
Establish dust isolation without blocking supply/return or exits.
Lock out and verify affected lighting circuits.
Remove only issued-scope items; log salvage and disposal.
Inspect protection daily and repair breaches.
checks: Retained items reconcile to the move log with no unrecorded damage.
No blocked egress, HVAC path, slider track or camera view.
Removed circuits are safe and identified.
handoff: GC supplies site-specific containment and disposal plan.
Electrician supplies outage/lockout record.

materials.name: Graduated antique-mirror arch panels
materials.spec: Illustrated 24-in widths and 80/86/92/86/80-in heights are template envelopes only; black-smoked antique appearance with approved gold-vein character.

materials.name: Safety backing/lamination and edge finish
materials.spec: Glass makeup and protected bottom/perimeter edges selected by glazier for the actual location.

materials.name: Mechanical retention and verified backers
materials.spec: Substrate-specific backers, retainers, clips/channels and compatible setting materials; loads and fasteners by issued design.

materials.name: Perimeter interface trim
materials.spec: Black or brass interface pieces coordinated with wall finish and removable halo access.

before: Complete M-03, M-07 and finished-wall/floor survey.
Approve a lit physical mirror sample and expected pattern variation.
Receive signed panel schedule, weights, safety-glass build-up and attachment detail.
steps: Field-template each unique arch, gap and edge from the finished datum.
Fabricator labels panels and dry-checks templates before cutting glass.
Install verified backers and inspect them before wall closure.
Complete wall finish and halo rough-in while keeping access removable.
Set panels on specified blocks/supports and engage engineered mechanical retention in labeled order.
Fit edge protection/trim and clean with manufacturer-compatible products.
Glazier performs and records final retention and edge inspection.
checks: Installed profiles match approved templates and A02 visual order.
No unsupported edge, sharp edge, unstable panel or trapped light-service component.
Panel labels, weights, retention and inspection photos are in the handover file.
handoff: Glazier issues exact cut files, glass makeup, weights, edge and setting requirements.
Qualified designer issues backing, loads, mechanical retention and fasteners.

materials.name: Antique ceiling-mirror visual assembly
materials.spec: 96 x 96-in proposed visual zone; module sizes and joints determined after ceiling survey.

materials.name: Support frame/backer
materials.spec: Independent support/load path sized to structure; removable access coordinated with lighting.

materials.name: Mechanical retention and secondary safety provisions
materials.spec: Supplier-designed hardware and fasteners for overhead use; adhesive is not the sole support.

materials.name: Perimeter trim/access panels
materials.spec: Finished black interface concealing light source while preserving driver and retainer inspection access.

before: Open and document the approved ceiling inspection point.
Obtain structural/support design, panel weights, glass safety build-up and installation/lift plan.
Coordinate detectors, HVAC, downlights, cove, drivers and access before fabrication.
steps: Survey structure and set out the assembly from the field-issued E01 datum.
Install and inspect the engineered support frame/backer before concealment.
Complete electrical/halo rough-in and verify removable service paths.
Stage, label and lift modules under the glazier’s approved plan.
Engage every specified mechanical retainer and secondary provision; do not rely on adhesive alone.
Install trim/access panels without hiding inspection points.
Support designer and glazier complete final documented inspection.
checks: Assembly is level, stable and matches approved module/joint layout.
Every retainer and support is inspectable or documented before closure.
Lighting and drivers can be serviced without removing unsupported glass.
handoff: Qualified support designer supplies loads, framing, anchors, sequencing and inspection requirements.
Glazier supplies module/cut schedule, weight, safety glass build-up and handling plan.

materials.name: Cabinet carcass and finished panels
materials.spec: 48-in nominal run, proposed 26-in depth and 42-in finished counter height; cabinet-grade core, thickness and black finish set by approved shop drawing.

materials.name: Serviceable door/panel hardware
materials.spec: Commercial hinges/slides, pulls or touch latches, removable fridge/service panels and stops; exact schedule pending design.

materials.name: Leveling/toe-kick components
materials.spec: Adjustable levelers/shims and finished toe kick compatible with floor decision.

materials.name: Ventilation grilles/openings
materials.spec: Keep candidate fridge front vent open and cabinet heat/service paths unobstructed.

materials.name: Backing/anchors
materials.spec: Substrate-specific restraint and blocking identified on shop drawings.

before: Complete M-11/M-12 and choose the refrigerator.
Approve 24-in versus 26-in depth through occupied/fridge-service mockup.
Coordinate finished floor, outlet, stone, glass front, shelves and lighting.
steps: Field-measure the run and service clearances from A03 datums.
Submit shop drawings showing materials, panels, hardware, vent, outlet and removable-service route.
Prefabricate and finish components; dry-fit the selected appliance opening.
Set, level and restrain the carcass to verified backing.
Verify appliance can insert, vent, open and pull out for service.
Release the installed carcass for stone template, then install finished service panels.
checks: Finished counter datum is correct and carcass is level/plumb.
Fridge vent, plug, door and pull-out path remain fully usable.
All service panels and hardware operate without colliding with stools or piano.
handoff: Millworker supplies material/hardware schedule and substrate-specific anchor detail.
Greg releases final bar depth and three-stool fit.

materials.name: Honed black stone or approved quartz top
materials.spec: Field-templated nominal 48 x 26-in top; exact material, thickness, slab/lot and eased edge selected by sample.

materials.name: Supports/brackets
materials.spec: Continuous cabinet support plus any concealed brackets required by final thickness/overhang.

materials.name: Compatible setting materials
materials.spec: Non-staining bedding/sealant approved by both surface and cabinet manufacturers.

before: Carcass is installed, level and accepted.
Final fridge/stool geometry and overhang are released.
Approve physical material sample, edge and seam plan.
steps: Field-template the installed carcass and mark walls, appliance and finished edges.
Fabricator issues cut/edge/support drawing and confirms cabinet capacity.
Dry-check top and protect finished cabinet faces.
Install supports and set top with approved materials.
Complete seams/edge finish and cure per manufacturer.
Verify fridge ventilation/service and clean/protect the top.
checks: Top is level, fully supported and matches approved edge/sample.
No unsupported overhang, blocked vent or appliance-service conflict.
Care/sealer instructions and material lot are recorded.
handoff: Stone fabricator provides exact material, thickness, weight, joint and support requirements.

materials.name: Smoked safety-glass infill
materials.spec: Tint/sample approved under 2700K light; glass type, thickness, edge and safety treatment by glazier.

materials.name: Brushed-brass trim/retention
materials.spec: Profile and finish sample coordinated with glass edges and cabinet service panel.

materials.name: Diffused backlight interface
materials.spec: Opaque/reflective backing and removable LED access coordinated with LGT-04.

materials.name: Compatible setting/seal materials
materials.spec: Non-staining materials approved for glass, metal and cabinet finish.

before: Bar carcass is installed and service openings accepted.
Approve lit glass and brass samples.
Receive glazier shop drawing with retention and edge details.
steps: Field-template the finished opening and removable service boundaries.
Fabricate and label glass and trim from approved template.
Complete backlight rough-in and test before glass closes the cavity.
Install specified retainers/setting blocks and fit glass without loading edges.
Install trim while preserving the service panel and ventilation.
Test light diffusion, dimming and panel removal; clean with compatible products.
checks: Glass is retained, edges protected and free of point loads.
Lighting is even and serviceable.
Fridge vent and service panel remain clear.
handoff: Glazier supplies glass makeup, weight, retention, setting and cleaning specification.

materials.name: Black-finished bottle shelves
materials.spec: Nominal 48 L x 10 D in; exact core, thickness, edge and finish selected by shop drawing.

materials.name: Rated shelf brackets/backing
materials.spec: Concealed or approved brackets sized for bottles/glassware and fastened to verified backing.

materials.name: Recessed LED channel covers
materials.spec: Removable diffusers/covers and cable chase interface coordinated with LGT-04.

materials.name: End stops or restraint detail
materials.spec: Detail to reduce bottle movement where required by final shelf design.

before: Complete M-07 and approve backing.
Approve bottle-height mockup, shelf AFF heights and representative load.
Coordinate LGT-04 feeds and removable cover.
steps: Field-mark shelf centers from A03 and verify backing/cable zones.
Submit shelf/bracket/load and LED-channel shop detail.
Install backing before wall closure and photograph dimensions.
Finish wall, then mount brackets with specified substrate fasteners.
Fit shelves and LED covers; route cables without pinch points.
Apply the specified proof load and document deflection/fasteners.
checks: Shelves are level, stable and match approved sample.
Rated load and fastener record are documented.
LED and wiring remain accessible; bottles do not block heat or fridge intake.
handoff: Millworker/designer provides shelf load, bracket and fastener schedule.

materials.name: Zephyr Presrv PRB15C01CG beverage cooler
materials.spec: 15 W x 23.375 D x 33.875–34.875 H in; front-venting built-in candidate. Final model/finish must be reconfirmed.

materials.name: Dedicated accessible receptacle/plug space
materials.spec: At least 1-in rear plug allowance plus code-compliant outlet placement; circuit by licensed electrician.

materials.name: Hinge-side clearance
materials.spec: Candidate manual minimum when adjacent to a wall; verify actual orientation.

materials.name: Floor/cabinet protection
materials.spec: Non-blocking pads/protection that do not obstruct leveling or front vent.

before: Confirm final model, finish, hinge orientation, price, warranty and delivery.
Approve cabinet shop drawing with 15.125-in minimum opening, 34-in minimum height, rear plug space and front vent.
Verify route and service pull-out path.
steps: Inspect delivered unit and model plate before modifying cabinetry.
Complete and test the receptacle before insertion.
Level the appliance per manual and slide it without pinching cord or blocking the front vent.
Set door/hinge clearances and verify full opening.
Run initial manufacturer start-up and temperature test.
Pull the unit out once to prove service access, then record serial/warranty.
checks: Unit is level, vent unobstructed and door opens without collision.
Cord/plug is not crushed and service pull-out works.
Temperature and lighting operate per manufacturer check.
handoff: Millworker releases final cutout and face projection.
Electrician confirms circuit and outlet location.

materials.name: JONATHAN Y Trinity 30-in backless bar stool
materials.spec: Target TCIN 89893519 / UPC 840011489117; black 17 W x 17 D-in metal body, 13.5-in round seat, 30-in seat height, gold metal hairpin legs/footrest, 275-lb published capacity, no assembly. Candidate only: three bodies span 53 in at the current 18-in centers and exceed the 48-in bar by 5 in.

materials.name: Finish-safe floor glides
materials.spec: Confirm supplied feet and any added glide are compatible with the released floor; do not add a glide that destabilizes the hairpin base.

before: Retain the A03 48-in bar and current 18-in stool-center geometry as the comparison baseline.
Tape three 17-in bodies at the actual bar: at current centers the outer span is 53 in; even three touching bodies need 51 in.
Operate the refrigerator door, south entry, adjacent lounge chair and piano bench with three occupied mock stools.
Approve a physical gold finish sample against the room brass before any three-unit order.
steps: Mark the 48-in counter run, current 18-in centers and three 17-in stool footprints from A03.
Seat three people and check the 12-in seat-to-counter height difference, knees, elbows, integrated footrests and counter overhang.
Test entry, refrigerator door/service, adjacent chair movement and piano-bench use with all three bodies in place.
Record any approved center shift or reduced quantity on the furniture plan; do not silently change the modeled layout.
After written fit and finish release, inspect each factory-assembled stool, fit approved glides if needed and place at the recorded centers.
checks: The accepted quantity and centers are documented; three stools are not represented as fitting within the 48-in run.
Every accepted stool is stable and leaves the entry, refrigerator and piano usable.
TCIN, UPC, black/gold finish, published capacity and care/warranty record are in handover.
handoff: Greg/furniture lead releases quantity and spacing only after the full-size occupied test.
Supplier confirms current stock, return terms and finish before order; the observed listing is not a reserved unit.

sources.label: Target — JONATHAN Y Trinity stool, TCIN 89893519

materials.name: Yamaha AvantGrand NU1X
materials.spec: Published 59.125 W x 18.25 D x 40.3125 H in; physical model and ownership must be confirmed.

materials.name: Piano bench
materials.spec: Identity, deployed envelope, finish and condition to be recorded in M-11.

materials.name: Floor protection
materials.spec: Caster/cup/pad system approved for piano weight and final floor without restricting leveling.

materials.name: Power/audio leads
materials.spec: Existing or replacement leads labeled and routed without trip/service conflict.

before: Read model plate and inspect condition.
Complete M-12 placement/bench test and M-15 delivery route.
Confirm final floor capacity/protection and accessible power.
steps: Photograph and label piano, bench, pedals and cables before moving.
Use qualified piano movers and protect thresholds/walls.
Place from the field-approved A03 datum, preserving the bar gap and bench envelope.
Level/stabilize per Yamaha/mover guidance and install approved floor protection.
Connect power/audio, manage slack and test keys, pedals and outputs.
Record final location, condition and model plate.
checks: Piano and bench match approved clearances and do not block entry/bar.
Instrument is stable, protected and fully functional.
Cables are labeled, serviceable and do not create a trip path.
handoff: Greg confirms ownership/model and final gap.
Qualified mover provides lift/move method for actual route and weight.

materials.name: Jennifer Taylor Home Alpine sofa
materials.spec: SKU 64190-3-MBB, Ebony Black boucle; use 90.5 W x 36 D x 27.5 H-in clearance envelope pending maker confirmation.

materials.name: Manufacturer leg/assembly hardware
materials.spec: Use only supplied hardware and current manufacturer instructions.

materials.name: Finish-safe floor protection
materials.spec: Pads/glides compatible with oak legs and final floor.

before: Resolve 90 versus 90.5-in width and approve upholstery sample/return terms.
Complete occupied M-12 mockup and M-15 route.
Confirm current stock, delivery service and damage-inspection procedure.
steps: Inspect packaging and upholstery before accepting delivery; record damage.
Move by approved route without loading arms or fabric incorrectly.
Install supplied legs/hardware in manufacturer order and fit approved floor protection.
Place to current A01 pose only after field layout release.
Level, allow cushions to recover and recheck occupied circulation.
Record SKU, lot, care and warranty.
checks: Finish, dimensions and two-cushion silhouette match approved reference.
Sofa is stable and clears all occupied/service paths.
Care/return/warranty records are delivered.
handoff: Manufacturer confirms published width discrepancy.
Greg approves exact fabric and occupied fit.

materials.name: IKEA DYVLINGE swivel chair, Kelinge black
materials.spec: Article 805.708.31; 24.75 W x 29.5 D x 26.75 H in, 16.875-in seat; black textured polyester textile and chrome-color five-star base.

materials.name: Manufacturer assembly hardware
materials.spec: Use supplied parts and current IKEA instructions; do not substitute.

materials.name: Finish-safe floor protection
materials.spec: Compatible with five-star bases and final floor without impairing swivel.

tools: torque tool only if manual specifies
before: Approve low seat and textile sample.
Complete both occupied/swivel envelopes in M-12.
Verify local stock, two-unit quantity, delivery and return terms.
steps: Inventory all parts against the manual.
Assemble each chair in manufacturer sequence and tighten only as directed.
Verify five-star base engagement and full swivel before placement.
Fit approved non-binding floor protection if needed.
Place at released A01 rotations and repeat occupied swivel/approach test.
Keep article, care and warranty records.
checks: Both chairs swivel freely, sit level and have no loose connections.
Textile is Kelinge black and is not represented as leather.
Placed chairs clear doors, table, desk and instrument/service paths.
handoff: Greg approves low seat and exact textile.

materials.name: Custom smoked-glass cocktail table
materials.spec: Preferred: quote 30-in diameter x approximately 16-in high, smoked/black tempered-glass top, black structural base and restrained brushed-brass rim/accent. Fabricator designs glass thickness, edge, support, stability and floor protection.

materials.name: By-Boo Bunga dimensional reference
materials.spec: Wayfair YBOO1890; 30-in diameter x 16-in high, black glass/conical black metal/gold rim. Exact visual/dimensional reference was out of stock when verified; do not order or imply availability.

materials.name: 17 Stories 30-in tinted-glass fallback
materials.spec: Wayfair W117302305; 30-in diameter x 17-in high. Candidate fallback only after Wayfair confirms the selected gold-base variant and tinted tempered-glass construction in writing because listing fields conflict.

materials.name: Floor-safe glides/pads
materials.spec: Specified for the actual base, rug and finished floor; custom fabricator includes and documents them.

before: Keep the A01 30-in-diameter x approximately 16-in-high table envelope as the preferred design.
Tape a 30-in circle and test occupied chair sweeps, seated reach and circulation.
Approve physical smoked-glass and brass samples under final lighting.
For the 17-in-high fallback, repeat the full-size reach and chair-clearance test and obtain written finish/glass confirmation.
steps: Issue the custom fabricator the approved envelope and finish brief; require a shop drawing for glass, edge, supports, stability and glides.
If using the buyable fallback, reconcile its listing fields in writing before ordering and record the exact variant.
Inspect tempered-glass marking, edges, base and all retainers before assembly or placement.
Assemble only to the maker/fabricator sequence without overtightening glass fittings; install specified floor protection.
Place at the released A01 center, level it and repeat seated reach, chair swivel and circulation checks.
checks: Installed table is stable, glass is safety-rated/retained and every edge is undamaged.
The accepted height and footprint work with both chairs, sofa and circulation.
Custom shop drawing or exact retailer variant, care data and replacement/retainer information are delivered.
handoff: Furniture lead chooses custom preferred or the held fallback after fit/sample review.
Custom fabricator supplies the engineered glass/support/stability detail; this card does not prescribe glass thickness.

materials.name: Custom dark patterned low-pile lounge rug
materials.spec: Preferred when the rendered footprint must be preserved: nominal 120 x 108 in (10 x 9 ft), with approved fiber, pattern, bound/serged edge and cleanability.

materials.name: Ruggable Sloane Black Flatwoven + Standard Pad, 8 x 10
materials.spec: SKU RUG-SYS-IND-RCT-CHN-SR007-08x10; charcoal/grey geometric cover with cream accents, 2-mm polyester cover/waterproof barrier plus required same-size nonslip Standard Pad. One foot narrower than the modeled 10 x 9-ft footprint.

materials.name: Ruggable Sloane Black Flatwoven + Standard Pad, 9 x 12 alternate
materials.spec: SKU RUG-SYS-IND-RCT-CHN-SR007-09x12; matches the modeled 9-ft short axis but extends 2 ft beyond its 10-ft long axis. Do not trim the cover or pad.

materials.name: Custom rug pad for custom 10 x 9-ft rug
materials.spec: RugPadUSA Eco-Plush 1/4-in, 100% felt, custom-cut slightly inside rug perimeter; no grip layer, so use only if heavy furniture securely anchors the rug and Karndean confirms compatibility.

before: Retain A01 modeled 120 x 108-in footprint as the comparison baseline; no standard size is a silent 3D substitution.
Tape 8 x 10 and 9 x 12 rectangles around the released sofa/chairs/table and verify doors, circulation, vents and service paths.
Choose custom 10 x 9 if preserving the render footprint matters more than a direct-buy system.
Approve the exact rug/pad sample and obtain written compatibility with the released finished floor.
steps: Clean and fully dry the finished floor; confirm the selected rug and pad are the same approved size/system.
For Ruggable, lay the same-size Standard Pad and align/smooth the cover from the center outward; do not cut either component.
For the custom rug, install the approved custom-cut felt pad slightly inside the edge with no pad exposed.
Orient the accepted footprint to the recorded A01 layout, allow it to relax and align all pattern/edges.
Place furniture without dragging; test chair swivel, table stability, edge lift and every adjacent route.
Record the selected SKU/size or custom edge specification and the manufacturer cleaning method.
checks: Accepted footprint is documented against the modeled 10 x 9 ft: 8 x 10 is 1 ft narrower; 9 x 12 is 2 ft longer.
Rug lies flat with no trip edge, pad exposure, blocked vent/threshold or rolling-chair conflict.
Cover, pad and finished-floor compatibility are documented; no Ruggable component was trimmed.
handoff: Greg/furniture lead selects custom 10 x 9, 8 x 10 or 9 x 12 only after the full-size furniture test.
Flooring supplier confirms long-term pad compatibility and warranty treatment in writing.

materials.name: Karndean Van Gogh Rigid Core Ebony SCB89
materials.spec: 14 x 23.64 = 330.96 sq ft for current 328.63-sq-ft allowance; final field takeoff and lot required.

materials.name: Transition/nosing profiles
materials.spec: Exact profiles/finish for doors, sliders, booth and raised platforms after M-08/M-16.

materials.name: Perimeter spacers and trim/base
materials.spec: Manufacturer-compatible expansion accessories and approved black/dark trim.

materials.name: Subfloor preparation materials
materials.spec: Patch/level/moisture products selected by installer for tested substrate.

materials.name: Spare flooring
materials.spec: Owner spare quantity set after carton rounding and final cut plan.

before: Greg chooses dark floor versus retained oak.
M-08 identifies existing floating/adhered assembly and substrate; floating floor is removed before this candidate.
M-16 resolves platform/threshold geometry and installer issues warranted assembly.
Use the current Karndean guide to document substrate flatness, concrete/wood moisture, expansion, fixture sequence and transitions; do not add separate underlay without written approval.
steps: Protect and inventory retained items; remove only the approved existing floor and preserve boards where feasible.
Prepare substrate to manufacturer flatness/moisture requirements and document readings.
Acclimate/store product as the current manual requires.
Set layout/start line and expansion zones from approved floor plan.
Install planks and cuts per manufacturer sequence, staggering and perimeter requirements.
Install released thresholds/nosings/base without pinning the floating field.
Clean, protect and record lot, cartons, spares and warranty.
checks: Installed floor is flat, stable and warrantable with documented substrate readings.
Doors, sliders, fridge and platforms operate over completed transitions.
Expansion zones and spare material remain documented.
handoff: Flooring installer supplies final takeoff, substrate products, transition/base schedule and written warranty.
Greg provides written approval before oak removal.

materials.name: Guilford FR701 style 2100 color 408 Black
materials.spec: 66-in usable width; production sample/dye lot and measured yardage required.

materials.name: FabriTRAK GeoTRAK black profiles
materials.spec: Final 0.5/1/1.375-in profile depth and linear footage selected with complete assembly.

materials.name: Acoustic core/backing
materials.spec: Core type/thickness, fire/acoustic documentation and substrate compatibility by acoustician/dealer.

materials.name: Perimeter/corner/outlet/HVAC trim
materials.spec: Track transitions and removable access details for all interruptions.

materials.name: Charcoal finish for approved solid walls
materials.spec: Maker/color/primer/sheens selected after mockup; never coat retained fabric.

before: M-07 documents wall build-up and M-14 establishes acoustic baseline.
Approve full assembly sample, dye lot, fire/acoustic documentation and solid-wall paint sample.
Issue wall elevations with fabric/solid/slat boundaries and access panels.
steps: Remove only finish layers approved after acoustic review.
Repair/prepare substrate and install verified blocking where required.
Install track/core from approved elevations, keeping devices, grilles and service panels accessible.
Stretch and lock fabric with seams and grain aligned; do not contaminate face.
Apply approved charcoal finish only to released solid substrates.
Complete junction trim at doors, slats, ceiling and floor.
Inspect, clean and remeasure acoustic response.
checks: Fabric is taut, removable where required and matches approved dye lot.
No covered device, grille, label or service access.
Finish disposition and before/after acoustic records are archived.
handoff: Acoustician/dealer issues exact track-core-fabric assembly, takeoff and test documentation.
Painter issues substrate/primer/topcoat system.

materials.name: WoodUpp Akupanel item 1029
materials.spec: 94.49 x 23.62 x 0.866-in candidate, black wrapped slats on black felt; final count/cut plan required because wall is assumed 102 in high.

materials.name: Battens and cavity insulation
materials.spec: Only if approved assembly uses expanded acoustic build-up; dimensions/material/test documentation by designer.

materials.name: Black termination/infill trim
materials.spec: Resolve 7.51-in height shortfall and all panel edges/joints.

materials.name: Panel fasteners
materials.spec: Manufacturer/system fasteners matched to verified substrate and backing.

materials.name: Penetration/access trim
materials.spec: For hangers, wiring, devices and removable service zones.

before: Field-verify both return lengths/angles, ceiling height and M-13 backing zones.
Approve panel sample, fire documentation and exact wall build-up.
Issue cut/termination plan resolving the 7.51-in shortfall.
steps: Lay out slat rhythm, joints, top/bottom termination and penetration centers on each return.
Install approved battens/backing/insulation without covering service paths.
Cut panels with supported faces and controlled dust.
Fasten at the approved pattern into verified substrate/backing.
Fit black infill/termination and trimmed access penetrations.
Photograph hidden fasteners/backing and inspect alignment.
checks: Slats are plumb, rhythm/joints match approved elevation and cut edges are finished.
Hanger/TV/service backing remains locatable and accessible.
Installed assembly matches submitted fire/acoustic build-up.
handoff: Architect/acoustician/installer releases panel count, cut plan, build-up and substrate fasteners.

materials.name: Benjamin Moore Aura Waterborne Interior Paint, Matte
materials.spec: SKU N522 in approved sampled black, such as Black 2132-10; published theoretical spread 350–400 sq ft/gal is not a buy quantity. Measure solid surfaces and price the substrate-specific coat schedule.

materials.name: Benjamin Moore substrate-specific primer/sealer/stain blocker
materials.spec: Painter selects from the current Aura N522 TDS for each verified substrate and existing coating condition; no universal primer is specified.

materials.name: Benjamin Moore Scuff-X Interior Matte optional high-touch alternate
materials.spec: SKU N484 in approved black formula for doors/trim or other high-touch solid surfaces only after side-by-side color/sheen mockup.

materials.name: Patch, prep, masking and protection materials
